inara_api_key.title: Inara API key
inara_api_key.description: Personal API key from inara.cz > Settings > Inara API. Leave empty to disable Inara tools. You can also enter it on the settings page (ask Claude to open ed-mcp settings), which needs no restart.

inara_dev_mode.title: Inara development mode
inara_dev_mode.description: Marks requests as test traffic to Inara. Leave off.

edsm_api_key.title: EDSM API key
edsm_api_key.description: API key from edsm.net > Settings > API Key. Leave empty to disable EDSM tools. You can also enter it on the settings page (ask Claude to open ed-mcp settings), which needs no restart.

capi_client_id.title: Frontier client ID (advanced)
capi_client_id.description: Leave empty to use the ed-mcp client. Set it only to use your own Frontier developer client.

ed_journal_dir.title: Journal folder
ed_journal_dir.description: The Elite Dangerous journal folder. On the gaming PC leave empty for the default; on a Mac choose the Syncthing copy.

ed_mcp_sync_dir.title: Sync folder
ed_mcp_sync_dir.description: Optional. A folder that Google Drive, iCloud Drive, OneDrive or Syncthing keeps in step, so plans and preferences follow you between computers.

ed_mcp_sync_password.title: Sync password
ed_mcp_sync_password.description: Optional. At least 12 characters. Encrypts your API keys and Frontier login. With a sync folder, they sync too. Use the same password on every computer.
